hooks.description: Append a session token/cost row to ~/.claude/diana/costs.jsonl
hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),os=require('os'),path=require('path');let input='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>input+=d);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const hook=JSON.parse(input||'{}');const transcriptPath=hook.transcript_path;const sessionId=hook.session_id||'unknown';const cwd=hook.cwd||process.cwd();let inTok=0,outTok=0,cacheW=0,cacheR=0,model='unknown';if(transcriptPath&&fs.existsSync(transcriptPath)){const lines=fs.readFileSync(transcriptPath,'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);for(const line of lines){let e;try{e=JSON.parse(line)}catch{continue}const u=e&&e.message&&e.message.usage;if(u){inTok+=u.input_tokens||0;outTok+=u.output_tokens||0;cacheW+=u.cache_creation_input_tokens||0;cacheR+=u.cache_read_input_tokens||0;if(e.message.model)model=e.message.model}}}const PRICES={opus:{in:15,out:75,cacheW:18.75,cacheR:1.5},sonnet:{in:3,out:15,cacheW:3.75,cacheR:0.3},haiku:{in:0.8,out:4,cacheW:1,cacheR:0.08}};const key=Object.keys(PRICES).find(k=>model.toLowerCase().includes(k));let cost=null;if(key){const p=PRICES[key];cost=(inTok*p.in+outTok*p.out+cacheW*p.cacheW+cacheR*p.cacheR)/1e6}const row={timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),session_id:sessionId,cwd,model,input_tokens:inTok,output_tokens:outTok,cache_creation_input_tokens:cacheW,cache_read_input_tokens:cacheR,estimated_cost_usd:cost};const dir=path.join(os.homedir(),'.claude','diana');fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});fs.appendFileSync(path.join(dir,'costs.jsonl'),JSON.stringify(row)+'\n')}catch(e){}process.exit(0)})"
